pass_1.title: Implementation & Verification of Native-Resolution Lidar Scarp Channels Lane
checks: Downloaded and verified competition inputs (sample_submission.tif, existing_faults.tif, training_features.tif), external lidar/cultural rasters (lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif, h52_scarp3m_100m.tif, topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif, derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif, tiger_road_distance_m.tif, blm_closed_claim_distance_m.tif), native 3 m pilot DEM tiles (x40y427_3m.tif, x42y425_3m.tif), and 70 registry comparator rasters.

Implemented src/gems64/lidar_scarp.py: Sare & Hilley (JOSS 2018) Scarplet template matching + AGU 2015 T31A-2838 slope-aware alluvial-fan detrending + Steger (1998) sub-pixel ridge lines + Frangi (1998) 2-20 m multiscale Hessian vesselness + 100 m cell aggregation + cultural mask.

Executed E1 (4-fold label-blind spatial CV, 8 km buffer, 48,441 withheld positives), E2 (4-fold buffered whole-component spatial CV, 300 m collar, 9,274 withheld positives), and E3 (native 3 m pilot tile AUC = 0.6617, off-catalogue SGMC fault recovery, and full-footprint emission).

Generated unique submission gems64-h64-lidar-scarp-cv-20261011T220000Z.tif (sha256: 346d57f0eca0ff36f7648f8b5a3ba8764054ab9e42e1677873791b83f460f45e) and strict NaN-outside twin gems64-h64-lidar-scarp-cv-20261011T220000Z-nan-outside.tif (sha256: ead50e13592a2facea8b01b9eceb292693a5b21c76319ab8cd9ae37a0e133f3b).

pass_2.title: Bug Hunt, Edge-Case Audit, and Physical/Statistical Corrections

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Steger (1998) applied directly to elevation z_det yielded zero line rate at the step midpoint u=0 because the second derivative of erf(u/s) vanishes at u=0.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Applied Steger (1998) and Frangi (1998) Hessian analysis to the scale-space step-gradient surface |grad_sigma z_det|, increasing synthetic scarp line rate from 0.0 to 0.859 and Frangi vesselness to 0.990.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Band 7 (strike) of lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif was stored relative to the image axis (circular mean 96.17 deg) rather than geological strike clockwise from North (12.01 deg).
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Applied exact 90-degree reference-frame rotation (strike + 90.0) % 180.0, aligning lidar scarp strike with Great Basin NNE fault strike.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Including road distance or mining-claim distance as linear classifier features introduced mapping-access bias and reduced holdout TPw (385.95 -> 364.30).
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Used the cultural-feature mask strictly to zero out non-tectonic lidar scarp channels and veto false-positive peaks in road/claim/canal corridors.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: 3.9 GB sandbox RAM limit with zero swap caused OOM when stacking dense full-footprint feature matrices simultaneously.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Implemented row-subset feature stacking (stack_subset) and explicit glibc heap trimming (malloc_trim) between pipeline stages.

pass_3.title: Final Alignment Check Against Original Prompt & Pre-Merge Gate
checks: Assigned lane (Native-resolution lidar scarp channels) implemented and verified with HOLDOUT-DTI gains on both range-front (+0.0189 E2 / +0.0304 E1) and off-range-front blocks (+0.0155 E2 / +0.0256 E1).

Both pre-placement probability surface (Spearman 0.3948 < 0.90) and final placed dots (Spearman 0.0661 < 0.90, discrete detector 3-px overlap 0.6301 < 0.70, vs H33-2-B2 0.2666 < 0.70) verified across all 70 registry rasters.
PhD-level analysis of H33-2-B2 (0.2778 ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED) and 5 ranked geological hypotheses documented in README.md and docs/research/findings.md.

GitHub Pages site (docs/) built and verified by scripts/check_site.py (0 broken links, prominent CLEARED FOR SUBMISSION banner, executive summary addressing [0,1] range error, unique submission name, and 116/140 char note).
All 40 pytest unit and integration tests pass.
